# Zevar Baksa

> Zevar Baksa is a jewellery house in Jaipur, India, making handcrafted 925 sterling silver pendants, earrings and necklaces with kiln-fired meenakari enamel and 22K gold kundan accents. "Zevar" means jewellery and "Baksa" means box. Every piece is designed from scratch with the artisan who makes it, and the artisans are credited with each collection.

Key facts:
- Founded 2026 in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Legal entity: ZevarBaksa LLP.
- Materials: solid 925 sterling silver, kiln-fired enamel (meenakari), 22K gold kundan settings.
- First collection: Meena Bagh, 24 pieces (necklaces and pendants, earrings), from ₹9,000.
- Sold online at www.zevarbaksa.com with prices in INR including GST, free insured shipping within India, online payment only (UPI, cards, net banking).
- Not to be confused with other jewellers named "Zevar"; the full brand name is Zevar Baksa.

## Shop

- [Meena Bagh collection](https://www.zevarbaksa.com/collection/meena-bagh): the first collection, 925 silver with meenakari enamel, a craft that travelled from Persia through the Mughal court to Jaipur
- [All jewellery](https://www.zevarbaksa.com/shop): every piece with price, material, weight and size
